name: agentic-atlas
description: Companion plugin marketplace for Agentic Atlas — field-tested patterns for designing agent systems, readable by people and consultable by agents over MCP at agentic-atlas.dev.

plugins.name: agentic-atlas
plugins.description: Do design work with Agentic Atlas over hosted MCP at agentic-atlas.dev/mcp/. Three skills — audit an existing agent artifact, design a new agent system, apply one named pattern — over two read-only agents; no SDK, CLI, local server, or content bundle is installed.
